examples.quote: This first slice accepts complete, unit-weight, fixed-effect Gaussian and binomial-logit models. Fits with active priors use an unclamped log-scale predictor; when passing `drm_control()`, set `logsigma_clamp=NULL` explicitly. REML, MSPL, structured effects, existing phylogenetic penalties and other response families refuse. If your analysis needs weights or random effects, fit that supported model without `priors`, or use another method whose regularization has been validated for that structure. Random-effect SD priors and tmbstan require separate validation. A wider prior or a different coding can change the result; use the resolved table and compare several scientifically plausible scales.
